title.en: Fable 8 — The Stag at the Pool

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A stag came to drink water in the morning.
The water was quiet like a mirror.

sentences.ar: הוא ראה את עצמו בתוך המים.
sentences.en: He saw himself in the water.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הקרניים שלי יפות מאוד.
sentences.en: He said: my horns are very beautiful.
They are big, and they rise upwards.

sentences.ar: ואז הוא ראה את הרגליים שלו.
sentences.en: And then he saw his legs.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הרגליים האלה דקות מדי.
sentences.en: He said: these legs are too thin.
I am embarrassed when I see them.
Suddenly he heard dogs from far away.
He began to run very fast.
The thin legs took him far.
The dogs remained a long way behind.
And then he entered into the forest.
His horns were caught among the branches.
He pulled, and did not manage to get out.
The dogs arrived, and he understood everything.
What is beautiful does not always help.
